findings.finding: Proper open embeddings is not defined. In the controlled-cobordism context proper means preimages of compact sets compact, under which h|U is generally not proper when U is a proper open subset of M, so the stated neighborhood P need not even be based at an admissible embedding. EK printed64 instead defines proper embedding by boundary respect: g^{-1}(∂N)=U∩∂M.
findings.repair: State ordinary open embeddings with the indicated boundary-respecting condition, or explicitly define proper in the EK boundary sense and explicitly disclaim map-properness. The proof needs no map-properness.

findings.location: Coordinate correction A, definition of R and quotient F
findings.finding: The author asserts nesting of λu([-4,5]×T) in S from common lower boundary and ordered disjoint upper boundaries, then uses between a boundary and its period translate for quotient injectivity. For the promised proof avoiding an annulus theorem, put the elementary clopen/bicollar argument into the text rather than relying on a picture or a general ordered-boundary assertion.
findings.repair: Use the common lower collar where W=λ and the connected interior to prove inclusion: an interior escape would meet a boundary of S, impossible by the disjoint slab bounds and embedding. Then describe the two sides of the supplied bicollared upper boundary and their λ-translates; a point and its adjacent translate cannot both lie in the open strip since the translate would be simultaneously above and below the same boundary. Larger translates are excluded by slabs. This supplies the actual seam/gluing injectivity argument.

findings.location: Relative finite assembly, first two paragraphs
findings.finding: The proof says cover C+ outside V by finitely many charts but subsequently uses the whole C+∪E in a Euclidean triangulation in each chart. On a general manifold this is not literally defined. The intended local compact-core restriction should be specified so no global triangulation is implicitly used.
findings.repair: Choose finitely many compact target cores C_i contained in chart interiors, with their interiors covering C+ outside the protected neighborhood; at stage i use only C_i and a compact neighborhood of (C_i∩D) together with the previously fixed compact cores in that chart. Keep the already fixed open neighborhoods in the protected input, shrink finite supports, and identify exactly which enlarged fixed compact set contains all f-dependent supports. No new topological triangulation theorem is needed.

positive_checks: Cut/stretch constants agree with EK85–86: a0=-11/3,b0=-10/3,a1=13/3,b1=14/3 and W=λω^{-1}λ^{-1}.
The radial compression preserves complement of Bk because its expansion factor is at least1; the extended lift is identity there.
Alexander scaling does preserve the stated attaching collar: a common collar near ∂Bk is outward stable under x↦x/s. No claim of preservation of arbitrary interior parameter fibers is needed.
The local degree argument supplies support containment in f(domain), so local stages preserve the embedding image.
The ambient conversion order J_s=p_s f^{-1}, B_s=J_s^{-1}, h_s=hB_s is correct, and pointwise fixing of protected D follows from actual neighborhood agreement.
Noncompact extension is explicitly excluded, and finite compact choices do not introduce full AC.
